key_insight: For the studied Minimum Vertex Cover instance, QAOA and FALQON follow distinct entanglement and coherence trajectories as they converge toward optimal solutions.
engineering_relevance: Variational resource tracking can help characterize optimization circuits without full quantum state tomography, but does not establish a quantum advantage.
method: Apply QAOA and FALQON to Minimum Vertex Cover.
Optimize auxiliary circuits to identify closest resource-free states using the Bures metric and Uhlmann’s theorem.
Track Bures entanglement and coherence across circuit depths.
evidence_signal: QAOA shows an early pronounced entanglement peak and residual coherence linked to solution degeneracy, while FALQON shows a lower, later entanglement peak and smoothly decreasing coherence.
watch_item: The abstract reports one problem instance and does not establish scalability or the overhead of auxiliary-circuit optimization.
paper_title: Resource Analysis of Quantum Optimization Algorithms via Variational Methods
